items.title: Fraud Rules Migration update
items.narrative:
# Fraud Rules Migration: on hold through the Q4 freeze

*Gmail · Friday Oct 9, 2026 · Fraud Rules Migration: on hold through the Q4 freeze*

**From:** Camila Yilmaz
**To:** Aisha Kumar, Hana Chen, Ruth Torres, Victor Hassan, finance-ai-spend@uber.example
**Date:** Fri Oct 9, 2026 22:40 UTC
**Subject:** Fraud Rules Migration: on hold through the Q4 freeze

---

Team,

The payments change freeze starts **Mon Oct 12** this year (two weeks earlier than usual) and runs to **Jan 11**. Since the Fraud Rules Migration cannot ship inside the freeze, **the project is on hold for now**. Please wrap up open PRs by Friday and move to the monitoring and model-review rotation.

Finance (cc): expect our API usage to drop for the rest of Q4; the migration budget carries into Q1.

Camila
